opening.argument: The speaker solicits financial participation in a Hashflare mining contract by presenting an improving purchase opportunity, directing viewers to an external link, and pairing that solicitation with a discount. He explicitly says, "if you go and you buy a contract for hash flare," then urges viewers to use the description link to buy Hashflare hashrate, while the description supplies a promotional code and referral URL. The offer is further sharpened by a stated 10% discount and a limited deadline, as he says he may put money into it before February 18th. Although he acknowledges that performance is "not wonderful yet" and recognizes the possibility of another market crash, he still points to expected Bitcoin growth and rising mining-contract performance to encourage the purchase.
